scope: Fictional operator Meranti Quay Terminals, 30 container berths across six Singapore port districts (Tuas, Pasir Panjang, Tanjong Pagar, Pioneer, Sembawang, Changi) serving the fictional manufacturer Halcyon Components
units: box moves (one container lifted on or off a vessel at the berth); yard moves (one container lift or shift in the terminal yard)

grains.RAW.BERTHS: one row per fictional container berth (mainline, feeder, transshipment, barge, reefer)
grains.RAW.BERTH_DAILY: one row per berth per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.EQUIPMENT_READINESS: one row per berth (ship-to-shore, tandem-lift, mobile harbour or barge cranes, or reefer monitoring racks snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.disruption_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(disruption in next 7 days) per berth, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day port-network box-move FORECAST; vessel waiting-time ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.BERTH_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic disruption-response SOPs (one per berth type and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.PORT_OPS_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.PORT_OPS_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, disruption, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (KPIs, daily on-time box moves, disruptions by berth, disruption risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
